Fixes #174.

Update the complete dependency tree across JavaScript, Rust, Python, Docker and GitHub Actions, and add weekly grouped Dependabot updates for every active manifest. JavaScript uses Playwright 1.64, Node 26.11.1 and npm 12.2.0; both Rust projects use edition 2024 and Rust 1.99; Python examples now have a locked Python 3.14.8/requests environment. Trixie images replace older distributions. A JavaScript major changeset and Rust 0.5.0 prepare releases for the raised runtime floors.

Release helpers now use locked Execa 10 imports instead of remotely evaluated packages. Native ESM/watch, upstream arrayBuffer downloads and a scaffold that imports the maintained service remove duplicated or obsolete code. Regression coverage verifies release argument handling, npm version gates, root package selection, clean installation after version bumps, binary response bytes and every Python example. CI compares the complete PR diff, so a research-only final commit cannot cancel earlier runs and skip code validation. Regression fixtures preserve docs-only PR optimization and exclude base-branch-only code changes.

The complete requirement analysis, alternative solutions, primary-source research, exhaustive before/latest/after tables and validation evidence are committed in [dev/log/issues/174/pulls/175](https://github.com/link-assistant/web-capture/tree/issue-174-191f66a951d0/dev/log/issues/174/pulls/175).

Validation:

- JavaScript: 523 tests passed across 61 suites; all lint/format/duplication checks passed; five final-image Compose endpoint tests passed.
- Release tools: eight tests and scaffold/binary/npm-lock regression probes passed.
- Live browser checks: 16 browser-engine, Wikipedia and GitHub tests passed with current byte-array PNG assertions; shared checks reduce duplicated blocks while preserving every signature and size assertion.
- Python: both fixture-based tests passed, covering all examples, encoding, exact output bytes and failures.
- Rust: formatting, minimal search/cache all-target Clippy, 15 unit/feature tests, one doctest and both dependency/TLS guards passed locally. CI passed full tests and doctests on Linux, macOS and Windows, all four enabled live integration groups on each platform, fresh consumer resolution, the bare-container build without system OpenSSL, release/package checks and the final Rust Docker image build. The 3 GB local container killed compilation of generated Chromium bindings; complete validation passed on CI runners.
- Both complete npm trees, Cargo and the complete Python environment have zero audit findings. Audit JSON is retained with the research.

Documented upstream exceptions: browser-commander 0.10 remains under existing #160 because latest 0.26.3 still mandates native SQLite for packaged consumers; the latest published official Node Docker image is 26.10.0 while source/CI is 26.11.1. Older transitive API generations include their parent constraints in the inventory. Both optional Kreuzberg musl packages publish 3.5.5, but their parent requires unavailable 3.7.2; npm 12 drops the necessary optional placeholders when regenerating a lock. Generate the compatible lock once with npm 11.13 and install/release with npm 12; reproducing and passing clean-install probes cover the defect, and both exact-version registry 404 responses are retained.

Playwright 1.64’s matching Noble image is not yet published; the existing matching-version CDN fallback remains enabled. The scaffold’s default install is also checked for clean npm 12 installation and preserved browser-download permission.

No endpoint, output format, feature, or existing assertion was removed. No visual UI changes.

All four workflows passed for final head eff0c02: [JavaScript and live/Docker tests](https://github.com/link-assistant/web-capture/actions/runs/37747601463), [Rust full matrices and release/Docker builds](https://github.com/link-assistant/web-capture/actions/runs/37747601420), [complete security and tooling checks](https://github.com/link-assistant/web-capture/actions/runs/37747601337), and [parity](https://github.com/link-assistant/web-capture/actions/runs/37747601511). The branch includes the latest main, and the working tree is clean.
